scripts.build:ui: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path out) { Remove-Item -Path out -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path static) { Remove-Item -Path static -Recurse -Force }" && next build
scripts.sync:static: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path static) { Remove-Item -Path static\* -Recurse -Force } else { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path static -Force }; Copy-Item -Path out\* -Destination static -Recurse -Force"
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run sync:static && npm run build:server
